body: Many people are aware of how the planets play a role in our lives via the zodiac seasons. But less are aware of the way the planets affect the energy of each day of the week. Because each day is associated with a planet, the seven days of the week each have a unique energy. This makes each day better suited to a particular theme or intention. When you are manifesting new intentions and setting new goals, choosing the best day of the week for your intention can set you up for success and supercharge your manifestation power. This PDF, the Ultimate Guide To The days Of The Week, will help you learn about the energy of each day and how to harness the energy for your goals. With the help of this guide, you can take full advantage of the energetic power of each day. PLEASE NOTE: This is a digital product (PDF download).
